exclusion_detail: The paper is inconsistent about compound 21: one step by direct purification in Section 2.2, three steps by Boc deprotection in the scheme caption; the reference cannot be fixed (both readers). (Reclassified 2026-10-24 after the verification pass.)

lead.label: 21 (HF50731)
lead.why: Abstract: 'a representative compound 21 (namely HF50731) showed strong CXCR4 binding affinity (mean IC50 = 19.8 nM)'; all later experiments use 21.

reactions.conditions: Dialdehyde (1 equiv), amine (2.05-3.00 equiv), 4 A MS, anhydrous MeOH, 70 C, 6-12 h; filter through Celite; NaBH4 (2-3 equiv), 0 C then rt 3-6 h; NH4Cl quench, concentrate (crude residue carried on in the Boc route).
reactions.source: Section 2.2, Scheme 1 step (a); Section 5.1.3 general procedure

notes: The paper is inconsistent about 21: Section 2.2 says 'direct purification to obtain compounds 21-25 and 35-36' (one step), while the Scheme 1 caption/experimental say Boc intermediates 10-20 are deprotected 'to afford compounds 21 and 26-34' (three steps; 26 and 27 are explicitly 'over three steps', 21's 32% yield is not labelled). The 3-step reading is the main one; the 1-step reading is in alt_variants. Intermediate 10's structure is my assignment (terephthalaldehyde-derived tetra-Boc), not printed. Final product reported as HCl salt; SMILES is the free base. Both starting materials are stated commercially available (general statement in 5.1). | EDITED 2026-10-24: the transcribed 3-step form was circular (the free polyamine was both the first product and the last), so only the one-step reductive amination of Section 2.2 is kept, with the amine listed twice (2 equiv incorporated).
